name: Rhox
body:
Rhox
CR 1/2

This fist-sized spider has a smoky black top side, but its underside is a vivid grape-like purple-red color.

XP 200
N Diminutive vermin (swarm)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 30 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +4 size)
hp 4 (1d8)
Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +0
Defensive Abilities swarm traits; Immune mind-affecting effects, weapon damage

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee swarm (1d4 plus poison plus distraction)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks distraction (DC 10)

STATISTICS

Str 1, Dex 15, Con 10, Int —, Wis 10, Cha 2
Base Atk +0; CMB —; CMD —
Skills Climb +10, Perception +4; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception; uses Dexterity for Climb checks

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Gruesome Death (Ex)

If the rhox’s target creature’s poison reduces the target to 0 Constitution, the target dies and explodes in a gruesome fashion covering all creatures within 10 feet of it in webbing. Targets within 10 feet of the exploding victim must make a DC 10 Reflex saving throw or the target is entangled by webbing. An entangled creature can escape with a successful Escape Artist check or burst the web with a Strength check. Both are standard actions with a DC 10. Attempts to burst a web by those caught in it suffer a –4 penalty. The webbing has 2 hp. Rhox do not become entangled in their own webbing and can walk across it at their climb speed. The save DC is Consitution-based.

Poison (Ex)

Swarm—injury; save Fort DC 10; frequency 1/round for 2 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, tangle (3-6 swarms) or colony (11-20 swarms)
Treasure none

The rhox is a rare spider that appears unremarkable at first glance, but when closely examined, the underside of each rhox has a weirdly human-like mouth studded with bony teeth at the junction of its thorax and abdomen. Its underside also has a multitude of short, stubby legs that move in succession, more like a millipede than a true spider. The venom of the rhox is extremely deadly, causing the victim’s fluids to congeal into a sticky, web-like fluid, particularly in the urine, before solidifying and bringing an agonizing death.
